text: Need a printer? Simple. Online, you find one, surprisingly cheap. Great deal! You buy it, feeling smart.
Printer works well. Then, 'low ink' alert. No problem, you think. Just buy more. How much could simple ink cost?
Search for ink. Your jaw drops. A new set costs almost as much as the printer! You feel tricked. What's the catch?
It clicks: the printer was the 'razor,' sold cheap to get you invested. The ink is the 'blades,' where profit lies. A classic business model.
You're locked in. To print, you must buy expensive ink. Your 'deal' was a disguised long-term commitment. You feel trapped.
Now, you see beyond sticker price. Look for total cost. You've learned to spot hidden systems, becoming a smarter consumer.
